WITH refund_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM refunds
  GROUP BY order_id
), paid_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count,
    SUM(o.amount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)) AS net_cents
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.id AS customer_id,
  COALESCE(p.paid_order_count, 0) AS paid_order_count,
  COALESCE(p.net_cents, 0) AS net_cents
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN paid_orders AS p ON p.customer_id = c.id
ORDER BY c.id;

WITH ranked_attempts AS (
  SELECT
    a.task_id,
    a.status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.task_id
      ORDER BY a.finished_at DESC, a.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM attempts AS a
), active_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.project_id,
    COUNT(t.id) AS active_task_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_latest_count
  FROM tasks AS t
  LEFT JOIN ranked_attempts AS ra
    ON ra.task_id = t.id
   AND ra.rn = 1
  WHERE t.archived = 0
  GROUP BY t.project_id
)
SELECT
  p.id AS project_id,
  COALESCE(ac.active_task_count, 0) AS active_task_count,
  COALESCE(ac.successful_latest_count, 0) AS successful_latest_count
FROM projects AS p
LEFT JOIN active_counts AS ac
  ON ac.project_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.id;

WITH active_tasks AS (
  SELECT id, project_id
  FROM tasks
  WHERE archived = 0
), latest_attempts AS (
  SELECT task_id, status
  FROM (
    SELECT a.task_id,
           a.status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY a.task_id
             ORDER BY a.finished_at DESC, a.id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM attempts a
    JOIN active_tasks t ON t.id = a.task_id
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
), counts AS (
  SELECT t.project_id,
         COUNT(*) AS active_task_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_latest_count
  FROM active_tasks t
  LEFT JOIN latest_attempts la ON la.task_id = t.id
  GROUP BY t.project_id
)

FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.project_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.id;
